title: Hun-Bot public artifact contract
description: What any producer (Hun-Bot's own collection adapters, the Research OS exporter) publishes for Explore, lineage strips, and future public surfaces. Owned by Hun-Bot. Producers map their internals onto it; Hun-Bot never reads a producer's internal schema. Design: docs/plans/2026-10-03-explore-living-atlas.md §2. Enforced by scripts/validate-artifacts.mjs (hand-written checks, no JSON Schema library); vocabulary in src/data/publicArtifactVocabulary.ts must match the enums here.

x-contract.compatibility: Additive optional fields and new pipeline stages are minor changes. Any change of meaning, a removed field, or a new required field is a major version; producers then emit both versions for one release.
minorRevisions: 1.1: optional artifact.series (blog series; language-independent id plus per-language title)
x-contract.exportLocation: Research OS writes src/data/research-os-export/public-artifacts.json (one export object). Hun-Bot's own export is built in memory at build time.

domain.description: Activity domain = Explore lane. Always explicit and already resolved by the producer; consumers never derive it.

localizedText.description: Human-written text by language. 'original' holds text in its source language when that is not a site language or unknown (e.g. a paper's title). A missing language is absent, never machine-filled.

id.description: '<kind>:<local id>'. Hun-Bot's public id, stable across builds. Never a producer-internal id. Local id: lowercase, no whitespace, ':', '?', '#', or leading/trailing '/'; Unicode letters allowed.

domainsAlso.description: Secondary domains. Shown in detail views; never move the mark.

time.description: Point kinds (paper, review, writing, resource, work) carry only 'start'. Span kinds (project, experiment) always carry 'end'; null = ongoing.

state.description: paper: selected | studied. review, writing, resource, work: published. project, experiment: planned | ongoing | paused | finished | abandoned.

topics.description: Active Hun-Bot topic ids (src/content/topics), already resolved through aliases and merges.

href.description: Internal site path per language, '/<lang>/…/', optionally with an in-page anchor ('/ko/research/#paper-<id>').

landmark.description: Owner flag: labelled in Explore's default view.

addedAt.description: When it entered the public site, YYYY-MM-DD.

sourceRef.description: Opaque producer reference (e.g. a Research OS item id). Hun-Bot never parses, joins on, or displays it.

series.description: Optional (minor revision 1.1). The series this artifact belongs to; null or absent = standalone. Hun-Bot emits it for blog writing.
A series of related artifacts. Every artifact in one series carries the same id and the same title, so a lane label never depends on which artifact is read.

id.description: Language-independent lane key: lowercase, no whitespace, ':', '?' or '#'. Internal, never a URL.

relation.description: A directed lineage edge between two public artifacts. Kind pairs and time order per relation are defined in src/data/publicArtifactVocabulary.ts (relationTypes).

basis.description: declared = the owner asserted it. verified = bibliographic evidence; only 'cites', only from research-os.

x-never.description: Documentary only. These exist privately and have no representation in this contract; validation rejects them by name with an explanation.

aggregate.description: One cell of the Research OS reading pipeline: count of papers at a stage, per month, per top-level topic. Only counts cross the boundary — no titles, no per-paper rows.

topic.description: A top-level active topic id (parent: null), or null for all topics. Deeper levels are reserved and currently rejected.

stage.description: Pipeline stage. Open set: consumers ignore stages they do not know (with a warning), so adding one is a minor change.

count.description: null = unknown, which is never the same as 0.
